description: JavaScript file defining a character map for TinyMCE editor, including functions to render the character map, insert characters, and preview characters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the character map popup by resizing it to fit content.

methods.name: renderCharMapHTML
methods.description: Generates and writes HTML for the character map table.

methods.name: insertChar
methods.description: Inserts a character into the TinyMCE editor at the cursor position.

methods.name: previewChar
methods.description: Previews a character in the popup interface based on provided character codes.
